random_field.policy: SHA256 seeded normal unit vector per typed field:value, sum supplied fields then L2

baseline_fit_scope: all primary-cohort unique metadata texts/categories per view; descriptive geometry only, never labelled fold-inductive response prediction
global_gene_policy: intersection of three previously frozen source-A-control gene panels, sorted original feature rows; expected2099; selection depends on all contexts' controls, not treated effects
local_gene_policy: each evaluated cell line uses its previously frozen LOCO source-only3000 panel, shared for all its dose strata
effect_metric: cosine similarity of frozen raw log2FC vectors, no response centering or residualization
zero_effect_policy: fail closed if any group contains a zero-norm effect vector; do not substitute cosine0, drop candidates or change cohort
representation_metric: cosine similarity, exact source-name vectors or declared baseline inputs
rsa: Spearman of upper-triangle effect and representation cosines; average ranks for ties, constant geometry NA; no pair-level p-values
effect_relevance: linear top10 effect-neighbor relevance excluding self; fractional equal allocation across exact boundary ties, sum10; all-effect-candidates-tied => non-discriminative NA
representation_ties: expected DCG under uniform exact-score tie order; IDCG from sorted fractional truth relevance
random_reference: analytic expected NDCG using query's own relevance mean and IDCG; report NDCG minus expectation, not normalized gain
aggregation: per-query metrics with valid counts, group means; descriptive equal-dose then equal-cell summaries; global scores separate; one independent study
source_data: group IDs/gene axes, full upper-triangle effect cosines and representation cosines float64, per-query neighbor metrics and per-group RSA; no selected favorable pairs
scope: descriptive context-associated geometry in one study, not prospective or fold-inductive prediction; no causal or cross-study inference
score_inspection_before_contract: six-encoder prediction outcomes known; E02 scores not yet computed under this contract
